letter_gimmick: Zero itself as the hero: a giant luminous numeral 0 (a hollow ring) floating in the void, the empty circle of a fresh day not yet started — the ouroboros of habit tracking with no animal inside it yet.
scene: A vast dark crimson void with a single enormous glowing ring-shaped zero at center, thin red concentric ripples radiating outward like a heartbeat monitor at rest. Faint ghost-silhouettes of unstarted habits — a coffee cup, a chess piece, a dumbbell — hover dissolved at the edges, waiting to be summoned.

label: Armadillo
letter_gimmick: The letter A as an architectural monument: the armadillo curled into a perfect sphere resting in the apex of a giant stone A, echoing the animal's armored arch — architecture as armor.
scene: A rolled-up armadillo sits like a jewel in the crossbar of a colossal red sandstone letter A rising from a desert plain at dusk. Its scute bands mirror the monument's strata, and slow breath-hold ripples of crimson air — a nod to apnea training — distort the horizon around it.

label: Buffalo
letter_gimmick: B as balance: the buffalo perfectly counterweighting objects on a giant scale shaped like the letter B, its two bowls formed by the letter's curves.
scene: A massive constructivist poster composition in deep reds and blacks: a buffalo stands calmly on one curved bowl of a titanic letter B that works as a balance scale, the other bowl holding a stack of books and a juggling club. Geometric rays and bold diagonals radiate behind, celebrating equilibrium.

label: Cheetah
letter_gimmick: C for checkmate and cardio: the cheetah mid-sprint across a chessboard desert, its spots reimagined as scattered chess pieces; the crescent of its bounding body forms the letter C.
scene: A cheetah explodes across an endless red-and-black chessboard savanna, blurred into repeated motion arcs by futurist force lines, pawns and kings tumbling in its wake like dust. Its spotted coat glows ember-red as if its cardio engine were overheating gloriously.

label: Dolphin
letter_gimmick: D as Dalí: the dolphin rendered in Salvador Dalí's melting-dream logic — because dolphins sleep half a brain at a time, the perfect lucid-dreaming coach.
scene: A crimson sea at golden hour where a dolphin arcs through air that drips like soft cheese, its reflection in the water showing the dolphin asleep and dreaming — the dream-bubble containing a tiny artist's hand sketching the scene itself. Melting clocks hang from driftwood in Dalí homage.

label: Elephant
letter_gimmick: E for Enlightenment era: the elephant as an 18th-century scholar in a grand library, trunk turning the pages of an enormous illuminated letter E.
scene: A candlelit baroque library stacked to the ceiling with leather folios, where a majestic elephant in a dust-red glow delicately flips the page of a giant glowing letter E made of books with its trunk. Chiaroscuro beams fall on spectacles perched on its wise, wrinkled brow.

label: Flamingo
letter_gimmick: F as the feathered fountain of youth: flamingos famously stand on one leg in perfect dental-floss-pink water; the letter F rises as a slender fountain in the lagoon.
scene: A Japanese woodblock-print lagoon at vermilion sunset: a flamingo stands on one leg atop a stylized letter F shaped like a bamboo fountain, while delicate wave patterns in pink and red ripple outward. Its feathers curl into Hokusai-style foam, and tiny white teeth-like lotus blossoms dot the water.

label: Gazelle
letter_gimmick: G as the Grand Canyon: the gazelle leaping the vast gorge, its arc tracing the letter G's curl — grace versus the grumpy blocker chasm below.
scene: A sublime romantic painting of the Grand Canyon bathed in dramatic crimson storm light, a gazelle frozen mid-leap across the chasm, spine perfectly arched (posture as art). Below in the shadowed gorge, a grumbling rock giant made of canyon stone — the grumpy blocker — fails to grab its hooves.

label: Heron
letter_gimmick: H as high-intensity training interval bars: the heron's legs are two pillars of the letter H, and it does explosive wing-burst intervals between them like a HIIT timer.
scene: A gleaming art-deco poster of a heron between two golden-red skyscraper pillars forming a monumental letter H, stopwatch dials and interval-timer bars in deco sunbursts behind it. The heron explodes upward in a vertical wing-clap, feathers like chrome streamline panels, sweat-red light streaks marking its work and rest phases.

label: Ibis
letter_gimmick: I as ancient Egypt's Thoth — the ibis-headed god of wisdom and writing — now depicted as the ultimate AI assistant, hieroglyphs turning into glowing circuit glyphs.
scene: A temple wall relief in profile-view Egyptian style: a sacred ibis stands on a giant ankh-like letter I, its eye a glowing AI circuit iris. Around it, traditional hieroglyphs morph into code brackets and juggling-club glyphs, painted in lapis, gold and deep red oxide, as if Thoth had just learned to program.

label: Jaguar
letter_gimmick: J as the jungle juggling ringmaster: the jaguar balancing glowing juggling clubs on its nose, rosette spots flaring like stage lights; the letter J is its curved tail holding a torch.
scene: A bold pop-art circus poster: a jaguar in a ringmaster's crimson coat juggles five glowing light-up clubs against halftone-dot jungle leaves, its tail curled into a giant letter J holding a flaming torch. Comic-style onomatopoeia bursts ('NEW RECORD!') explode in yellow stars around the record-breaking act.

label: Koala
letter_gimmick: K for Kyoto: the koala as a gentle Zen monk in a Kyoto temple garden, offering a tea bowl to a stranger; the letter K formed by two crossing bamboo stalks.
scene: A minimal sumi-e ink painting with a single red accent: a koala in a monk's robe kneels on a Kyoto temple veranda, offering tea to a faceless stranger, maple leaves drifting in the wind. Two crossed bamboo stalks behind them form a soft ink-brushed letter K, and the whole scene breathes quiet kindness.

label: Lion
letter_gimmick: L as the Library of Alexandria's last shelf: the lion as a linguist king, roaring new words into dictionaries; its mighty chest-expanding yawn doubles as the lung stretch.
scene: A renaissance oil painting of a noble lion seated on a throne of dictionaries in a vast candlelit library, one paw on an open tome, mid-roar that visibly stretches into ribbons of letters from a dozen alphabets swirling upward. Its chest is painted heroically expanded, breath made of golden words, in deep crimson chiaroscuro.

label: Macaw
letter_gimmick: M as the magician's stage: two macaw wings form the peaks of the letter M like red velvet curtains parting to reveal a floating meditation mandala where the bird's body should be.
scene: A symbolist theater of the mind: crimson stage curtains shaped like a giant letter M part to reveal a scarlet macaw levitating in lotus pose, its wings outstretched, feathers dissolving into a radiant golden mandala. Below, top hats spill over with glowing orbs — magic and meditation merged into one enigmatic ritual.

label: Narwhal
letter_gimmick: N as the North Star navigation: the narwhal's tusk is a compass needle pointing to a star-shaped letter N in the aurora — the unicorn of the sea needs no caffeine, only starlight.
scene: A swirling post-impressionist Arctic night in molten orange and teal: a narwhal breaches through glassy water, its spiral tusk aligned with the North Star, which blazes as a celestial letter N inside the aurora. In its other flipper-ish grin it politely declines a floating coffee cup, pushing it away with the tusk's tip.

label: Octopus
letter_gimmick: O as the Om: the octopus curled into a perfect O, eight arms in eight mudras, chanting Om — the most flexible meditator in the ocean.
scene: A lush art-nouveau panel of whiplash curves: an octopus curled into a living letter O, each of its eight arms ending in a different delicate yoga mudra, suckers blooming like gold-leaf flowers. Behind it, a mandorla of orange stained glass radiates the Sanskrit Om, kelp tendrils framing the scene in Klimt-like ornament.

label: Peacock
letter_gimmick: P as the peacock's pushup plank: the bird in perfect plank position, its fanned tail forming the loop of the letter P — one thousand reps of pure plumage.
scene: A crisp flat-vector gym poster in sunset orange and deep navy: a peacock holds a flawless plank, sweatband on its head, tail fully fanned upward to form the bowl of a giant letter P. Rep counters float as clean geometric badges (1000!), and a tiny laptop at its beak shows a terminal mid-compile — coding gains and pushup gains in one set.

label: Quokka
letter_gimmick: Q as the question mark's tail: the eternally smiling quokka leaning against a giant letter Q that morphs into a '?', the happiest philosopher on Rottnest Island.
scene: A warm naive-folk painting of an Australian island at honey-orange dusk: a beaming quokka leans against a giant hand-carved wooden letter Q whose tail curls into a question mark, one paw raised mid-question like a student. Speech bubbles full of tiny questions float like lanterns over tea-colored waves and patterned eucalyptus trees.

label: Raven
letter_gimmick: R as Raven's gothic library descent: the raven dives down the spiral staircase of a vast library shaped like the letter R, each step a deeper layer of the rabbit hole of knowledge.
scene: A brooding gothic scene in amber candlelight and black: a raven with eyes like burning embers spirals down an impossible staircase inside a letter R carved from bookshelves, feathers scattering torn academic paper pages that ignite mid-air. Below, the staircase tunnels into darkness — the rabbit hole — lit only by the bird's ember gaze.

label: Snow Leopard
letter_gimmick: S as the strength curve: the snow leopard's serpentine spine forms the letter S mid-deep-squat, its rosettes turning into rising suns — the ghost of the mountains doing leg day.
scene: A hybrid woodblock-miniature masterpiece: a snow leopard in a deep squat on a Himalayan ridge at tangerine dawn, its arched body tracing a perfect letter S, rosette spots blooming into tiny golden suns. Snow particles swirl in stylized wave patterns while the mountain itself curls like a persian paisley beneath its powerful hind legs.

label: Toucan
letter_gimmick: T as the treetop tea talk: the toucan's giant beak balances a tray of sleep-tracking tea cups, offering one to a stranger on a neighboring branch — the letter T is the branch itself.
scene: A vibrant cubist canopy fractured into orange and emerald facets: a toucan perched on a branch that forms a bold letter T extends its enormous beak across the canvas, balancing a tea tray with steaming chamomile cups labeled with tiny crescent moons. It leans toward a shy, geometric stranger-bird, mid-conversation, speech-shards of friendly shapes between them.

label: Uakari
letter_gimmick: U as the umbrella of the understory: the red-faced uakari juggling unique rainforest fruits under a banana-leaf umbrella shaped like the letter U — unusual and kind, sharing fruit with forest strangers.
scene: A saturated tropical-modernist composition of layered leaf shapes in emerald and lime: the crimson-faced uakari stands beneath a giant banana-leaf umbrella bent into the letter U, juggling five impossibly unique Amazonian fruits in an arc. With its free hand it offers a sixth fruit to a tiny shy tree frog, the whole scene humming with generous green light.

label: Vulture
letter_gimmick: V as the vintage videocassette: the vulture in flight formation forming a letter V, wings trailing film-strip ribbons — nature's own movie night, a scavenger of stories.
scene: A retro-futurist sky in mint and jade neon: a vulture glides in a crisp V-formation with its own reflections, each wingtip unspooling glowing celluloid film strips that loop into a giant letter V. Below, a desert drive-in movie screen made of green aurora light plays a tiny western, the vulture's shadow its sole audience.

label: Wolf
letter_gimmick: W as the wilderness writing desk: the wolf howling at a giant moon that is actually an inkwell, quill in paw, drafting its memoir — the letter W formed by two mountain peaks it sits between.
scene: A raw expressionist night in slashed greens and blacks: a wolf sits between twin jagged peaks forming a letter W, quill in paw, writing furiously on parchment that unrolls down the mountainside. The full moon above is a swirling inkwell, and green paint strokes howl outward from its throat — words made visible as aurora.

label: X-ray Tetra
letter_gimmick: X as the x-ray vision over the chessboard: the transparent tetra swims above submerged chess pieces, seeing through every gambit — X also the chess notation for a capture.
scene: A luminous natural-history plate come alive: an x-ray tetra with its famously transparent body glides through deep green water above a sunken chessboard, its see-through silhouette revealing tiny glowing organs shaped like chess pieces. Each chess square it passes over lights up in bioluminescent green, and a giant soft letter X marks a recent capture below.

label: Yak
letter_gimmick: Y as the yak's why: the philosophical yak of the Tibetan plateau, chewing on the question 'why?' — its horns curve into the letter Y, the eternal fork of curiosity.
scene: A richly detailed thangka-style scroll in jade, gold and vermillion: a monumental yak stands on a lotus-mandala plateau, its great curved horns framing a glowing letter Y from which a golden question mark rises like incense smoke. Prayer flags printed with tiny 'why?' glyphs flutter in green wind, and the yak's calm eyes hold patient, joyful curiosity.

label: Zebra
letter_gimmick: Z as the zebra's own stripes and the movie marathon: the zebra lounging on a zebra-striped couch watching Zoolander — its stripes ripple into the letter Z and the film's iconic walk-off poses.
scene: A dizzying op-art living room where zebra stripes, the letter Z, and cinema screen-glow all vibrate in emerald and black: a zebra reclines on a striped couch, popcorn in hoof, watching a green-tinted TV displaying two dramatically posing models. Its own stripes warp into concentric Z spirals, as if the optical pattern itself were binge-watching along.
